# Copilot Skills — Installed in This Repository

This repository includes **250 Copilot skills** from the [awesome-copilot](https://github.com/camillanapoles/awesome-copilot) collection.
Skills are available globally to all agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude, and others) in `.github/copilot/skills/`.

## How to Use

### GitHub Copilot
Type the skill name in chat (e.g., `@workspace /conventional-commit`) or reference it in your workflow.

### Claude Agent
Use the `skills-index` command: `/skills-index` to see all available skills, then reference them by name.
